[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:387YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Kallavesa, Seconded: Temeschwar">Construct the Forge of Bonds in the Fingers, Hahnmark. This will create the position of Keeper of Oaths, to be elected by the Loyalty Assembly with tenure. This is a time sensitive opportunity to create an edifice which would allow the Keeper of Oaths to carve one oath per season into the Fingers via a statement of principle. This has been fully funded and there are no upkeep costs
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs an [[edifice]] in Wood Heath, [[Hahnmark]]
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Carved in stone]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Autumn 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 11 wains of white granite
* 33 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Forge_of_Bonds}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Keeper of Oaths]] will be available to appoint for the first time at the Winter Solstice 387YE by the Loyalty Assembly
